body.en: Not a step — it runs under every one of them.
body.zh: 這不是一個步驟，而是貫穿每一步的前提。

body.en: Between unrelated tasks — and when the same thing has been corrected twice, clear and write one new prompt
body.zh: 不相關的任務之間；同一件事糾正兩次還是錯，也清掉重下一個新 prompt

body.en: Roll the code or conversation back to an earlier prompt
body.zh: 把程式碼或對話退回先前的某個 prompt

summary.en: Tell Claude what it can't see, and enforce what can't have exceptions.
summary.zh: 告訴 Claude 它看不到的事，並強制執行不容例外的規則。

body.en: Keep it short: only what Claude can't find by reading the repo.
body.zh: 保持精簡：只寫 Claude 讀程式碼也找不到的事。

body.en: Procedures and team knowledge, read in full only when a task calls for it.
body.zh: 流程與團隊知識，任務需要時才讀取全文。

body.en: For a rule with zero exceptions — applied every time, whatever the model decides.
body.zh: 給零例外的規則：不管模型怎麼判斷，每次都會執行。

body.en: allow / ask / deny rules; deny holds in every permission mode.
body.zh: allow / ask / deny 規則；deny 在任何權限模式下都有效。

summary.en: When you don't know exactly what you want yet, let Claude ask until the answers add up to a spec — including what's out of scope.
summary.zh: 還不確定要什麼時，讓 Claude 反問到答案能拼成一份 spec，包含不做的範圍。

body.en: The spec becomes a written definition of done.
body.zh: 這份 spec 就是寫下來的完成定義。

items.code: Interview me until you could write the spec, then write it to SPEC.md.

summary.en: In plan mode Claude reads files and runs commands to explore, but doesn't edit your source.
summary.zh: 在 plan mode 裡，Claude 會讀檔、執行指令來探索，但不改原始碼。

body.en: Cycle into plan mode mid-session, or start in it.
body.zh: 在 session 中切換進 plan mode，或一開始就用它啟動。

summary.en: Claude presents a plan; you approve it, or keep planning and say what to change.
summary.zh: Claude 提出計畫；由你核准，或選擇繼續規劃並說明要改什麼。

body.en: Open the proposed plan in your editor and edit it directly.
body.zh: 在編輯器打開提出的計畫，直接修改。

summary.en: Start a fresh session to build from the spec, so the build begins with a clean context.
summary.zh: 開一個新 session 依 spec 實作，讓實作從乾淨的 context 開始。

body.en: Clear first, then point Claude at the spec.
body.zh: 先清空，再讓 Claude 依 SPEC.md 實作。

summary.en: Give Claude a check that comes back pass or fail — tests, a typecheck, a linter, a screenshot next to the mockup — and ask for evidence.
summary.zh: 給 Claude 一個會回報通過或失敗的檢查（測試、type-check、linter、截圖對照設計稿），並要它拿出證據。

body.en: Keep going until the check passes.
body.zh: 一直做到檢查通過為止。

items.code: /goal all tests pass and lint is clean

summary.en: Review the diff in a fresh subagent that never saw your conversation, against the spec.
summary.zh: 用沒看過這段對話的新 subagent，對照 spec 審查 diff。

body.en: Or ask a subagent to check every requirement in SPEC.md — and skip style.
body.zh: 或請 subagent 逐條檢查 SPEC.md 的需求，並略過風格問題。

summary.en: Ask Claude to open the PR, then review it before submitting and have Claude highlight the risks.
summary.zh: 請 Claude 開 PR，送出前先審，並請 Claude 點出潛在風險。

body.en: Ask for it directly, or step by step.
body.zh: 可以直接要求，也可以一步步引導。
